invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Iterator, which is never explicitly set to null in the code.
Since result is created by Collections.singletonList(...).iterator(), it always starts with one element, so hasNext() is true.
The partitionPath is passed directly to HoodieCreateHandle; a null value would likely be prevented earlier for correctness.
fileId is used in constructing HoodieCreateHandle and should not be null for correct behavior.
recordMap is passed to HoodieCreateHandle and used in handle.write(), indicating it should not be null.
